name: dsh-agent-manager
description: Stop and really remove subagents and Agent Teams teammates: retire their catalog/roster records in the parent session log (seq-preserving tombstones) and move their session directories to a recoverable trash — or delete them outright with purge. Shows the running plugin version in the panel. | 子代理/团队成员管理：停止运行实例、从子代理目录与团队花名册中真正移除，会话文件进可恢复回收站，也可选彻底删除。

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/session-log.js && node --check lib/cli.js && node -e "import('./lib/index.js')"
